# GetJobsCanada (https://getjobscanada.ca)

> GetJobsCanada is a premier job board and career discovery platform connecting skilled professionals, newcomers, and Canadian citizens with verified employers across Canada.

## Overview
- Platform Name: GetJobsCanada
- Official Website: https://getjobscanada.ca
- Primary Audience: Canadian job seekers, international candidates eligible to work in Canada, and Canadian employers hiring full-time, part-time, remote, and contract talent.
- Geographical Coverage: All 10 Provinces and 3 Territories of Canada (Ontario, British Columbia, Alberta, Quebec, Nova Scotia, Manitoba, Saskatchewan, New Brunswick, Newfoundland and Labrador, Prince Edward Island, Yukon, Northwest Territories, Nunavut).

## Core Capabilities & Features
- Job Search: Search thousands of verified job postings categorized by industry, location, NOC code, employment type, and remote status.
- Employer Verification: Verified Canadian companies offering competitive salaries in CAD, health benefits, and career advancement.
- Indigenous & Inclusive Employment: Dedicated support for inclusive hiring practices and Indigenous community recruitment.
- NOC Code Classification: Full alignment with Canada's National Occupational Classification (NOC 2021) system for immigration pathways (Express Entry, PNP, LMIA-compliant postings).

## Key URLs
- Browse All Jobs: https://getjobscanada.ca/jobs
- Post a Job (Employers): https://getjobscanada.ca/post-a-job
- Employer Pricing & Packages: https://getjobscanada.ca/pricing
- About GetJobsCanada: https://getjobscanada.ca/about
- Contact & Support: https://getjobscanada.ca/contact
- Terms of Service: https://getjobscanada.ca/terms
- Privacy Policy: https://getjobscanada.ca/privacy

## Target Industries
- Information Technology & Software Engineering
- Healthcare & Nursing
- Trades, Construction & Natural Resources
- Administration, Office & Customer Service
- Finance, Accounting & Banking
- Education & Social Services
- Transportation, Logistics & Supply Chain
